summary: Unlinks node a2 from a doubly linked list whose head pointer is stored at this+0x204. Node layout per the raw source: next at node+0x10, prev at node+0x140. When the node has a prev, sets prev->next to the node's next; when it has a next, sets next->prev to the node's prev; when the node is the list head (this[129] == a2), advances the head to the node's next (the list becomes empty if the node had no next). Returns 0. Called by SceneGraph during scene-graph cleanup.

If the removed node's next pointer (a2+0x10) is non-null, take the next-linking path; a null next means the node is the tail.
Set the next node's prev pointer (v3+0x140) to the removed node's prev (a2+0x140), splicing the node out from the next side.
If the removed node is the list head (this[129] == a2), take the head-update path.
Advance the list head at this+0x204 (this[129]) to the removed node's next (a2+0x10); if the node had no next, the list becomes empty (head = 0).
